name: Yuru Plus
source:
If you're itching to get into the panties of the Yuru Yuri girls, then this is the doujin game for you! Join the adorable Kyoko and Yui for hours of cute romance and fully-animated sex scenes! All the sex is between you, the protagonist, and the girl of your choice, with a variety of tantalizing scenarios featuring beautiful professional-grade artwork. Yuri fans should note that there is no lesbian sex in this game.

[from [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/DJS5880]J-List[/url]]
